name: CAD/CAM
description: Are you interested in Computer Aided Design and Manufacturiong (CAD/CAM)? Become a member and enjoy 24/7 access to our CAD/CAM workstations and software!

benefits.title: Mastercam
benefits.description: Access professional CAM software for toolpath generation and CNC machine programming, enabling precise manufacturing of your designs.

benefits.title: VCarve Software
benefits.description: Use VCarve for vector design and 2D/3D carving, perfect for creating detailed cuts and engravings on wood, plastic, and other materials.

benefits.title: Design Software Suite
benefits.description: Design with industry-standard tools including Fusion 360, FreeCAD, and NX, giving you flexibility to choose the software that works best for your projects.

benefits.title: Professional Computer Workstations
benefits.description: Work on powerful, dedicated computer workstations optimized for CAD/CAM applications, ensuring smooth performance for complex designs and large files.
